profile.name: Robinhood Chain
notes: Universal Router row labelled plain "UniversalRouter" in Uniswap v3/v4 docs (0x8876789976dEcBfCbBbe364623C63652db8C0904) is 2.1.1 per the SDK and is sunset 21 Oct 2026; deployments.json instead lists unversioned UniversalRouter 0x06AfBA43Fd06227fA663b0DAecF536f6EaA6bf99 (code present, version not stated). Use only the 2.1.2 address.
V4Quoter runtime is 6118 bytes vs 5820 on Base/Arbitrum (different v4-periphery build, deployments.json sourceRef 56928a9); ABI compatibility not checked here.
Chainlink directory has no L2 Sequencer Uptime feed for Robinhood although Robinhood docs tell integrators to check one.
ETH/USD feed is a DualAggregator (Shared SVR): primary proxy 0x78F3... gives the standard view, secondaryProxy 0x5058... gives the SVR view. Both read aggregator 0x6091... (verified on-chain).
Multicall3.getBlockNumber() returns the L1 block estimate on Nitro (26,099,656 at L2 block 77,637,295); use ArbSys.arbBlockNumber() for the L2 number.
Robinhood docs list an "L2 Multicall" 0x2cAC2D899eCC914d704FeaAE33ac1bF36277DaD1: a different contract from Multicall3.
Mds1 multicall3 deployments.json does not list 4663, but the canonical Multicall3 runtime is present (codehash identical to Base/Arbitrum).

profile.name: Base
notes: Chainlink SVR is on by default on Base: the long-standing ENS eth-usd proxy 0x71041ddd... is the DualAggregator secondary proxy (SVR view, may lag by the cutoff when reports go through the private route); 0x50015f8b... is the primary (standard view). Both read aggregator 0x05c84a58... (verified on-chain, same answer at the check block).
Base docs: Flashblocks may be deprecated in the planned (not finalized) Denim hardfork in favour of canonical 200 ms blocks; block-count based windows would change 10x.
Base has native precompiles (B20, PolicyRegistry) that stock Foundry/Anvil cannot simulate (Base ships base-anvil); relevant only if Domino touches them.
Universal Router 2.2.0 also exists on Base (0xBE2257d1aAfBE6B73F67A9ac971C2F0B344Bb3c5, code present) but the API default and recommendation is 2.1.2.
sources: https://docs.base.org/specifications/flashblocks.md (2 s blocks, 200 ms flashblocks, Denim plan)
